Title: Info
Text:
The listbox objects have a new property named "Column Auto-resizing".
When this property is set, the columns widths will change automatically when the listbox is resized!

- Only resizable columns will be modified

- Columns will be resized only if the horizontal scrollbar is not active. In other words, the horizontal scrollbar thumb must disapear before any column can be resized.

- Columns will be resized from right to left according the the min and max settings of each column.

- When all the maximum values are reached, a fake column will be displayed on the right side of the listbox.

- When all the minimum values are reached, the horizontal scrollbar thumb appears again.
